title: 민주화운동기념사업회법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:19513:20060612:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Regulations on Personnel Management of the Senior Executive Service) <Presidential Decree No. 19513, June 12, 2006>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (94) Omitted.

(95) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (3) 1, "a public official of Grade I or a public official of equivalent rank" shall be replaced with "a general-service public official belonging to the Senior Executive Service or a public official of equivalent rank".

(96) through (241) Omitted.
